start: READY: a mutation from an open view must bind the record and version the user actually reviewed, not whichever record is current when its handler runs.
finding: The first two paths carry the reviewed intent. Revocation instead selected the latest declaration at dispatch, so a view of A could end B created in another tab.
repair: Expose an opaque governing-record reference and matter version on read; require both before revocation and retain store CAS. Legacy declarations receive a content-bound reference rather than an invented request key. Reject malformed, changed and expired targets without writes.
verification: PENDING: served positive, malformed/stale/wrong-target/expiry/no-write controls; shipped JavaScript must use the captured view, not mutable application state.
completion_claim: NONE: diagnostic record, not acceptance evidence or legal approval.
